text: Security is essential in web development. First, always use HTTPS to encrypt data between the user and the server. This protects sensitive information like passwords. Second, authentication confirms that users are who they claim to be, often through passwords or two-factor methods. Third, input validation checks what users enter, preventing harmful code from reaching your system. Without these steps, websites face common vulnerabilities such as SQL injection, cross-site scripting, and data leaks. Developers must also keep software updated and follow best practices. Good security builds trust and keeps both users and data safe.
